title: The Efficacy of the Nanit-Insights App in Improving Infant Sleep
brief_summary: The proposed study aims to examine the effectiveness of Nanit-Insights, an app-based intervention for parents who wish to improve their infant's sleep.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infant aged 5-7 months
* Presence of a moderate to severe sleep problem at baseline
* Sleeping arrangement in which the infant sleeps in a crib at night

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
